news.title: Alonso on building defensive partnerships and Colwill and Lacroix qualities
news.title_zh: 阿隆索谈建立防守伙伴关系以及科尔威尔和拉克鲁瓦的品质
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso has highlighted the importance of his Chelsea defenders forging strong partnerships, with the Blues manager spotlighting the complementary qualities of Levi Colwill and Maxence Lacroix ahead of our trip to Arsenal. The centre-backs are at different stages of their Chelsea careers. Colwill has long been part of the set-up at Stamford Bridge after coming through our Academy, while Lacroix joined the Blues from Crystal Palace this summer. The duo have been tentpoles of Alonso’s defence so far, starting in both of our Premier League fixtures as we opened the campaign with back-to-back wins over Fulham and Brighton & Hove Albion. Ahead of another tough challenge – an away trip to the Emirates Stadium on Sunday – our manager discussed the strengths of the two centre-backs and Lacroix’s instant adaptation to his new team. ‘We need to have good balance and for sure we know the best qualities of Levi – he's important to our build-up,’ said Alonso. ‘More in this left channel, not so on the wing, when he has different diagonal passes that he's able to see and he's able to find players in the pocket and see the other [right pocket]. But we need to have a good partnership in defence. ‘Maxence is very consistent, he's strong, he's very connected to the game in terms of personality, in terms of awareness, and we have players that want to have that impact. This is very good. Maxence has been here just for three, four weeks, but he's really settled into the team.’ Alonso also discussed how he is shaping his Chelsea side, with there being an emphasis on flexibility and incisiveness to ensure the Blues can overcome every kind of challenge we will face this season. ‘What we want is that we are able to adapt,' he said. 'For sure there will be games that we have a lot of possession and struggle to score against teams that defend in a low block. ‘But to have different tools, to have different ideas how to do it, and to have different approaches, is good. ‘We are in the early days. We have had two games, two wins, but we are aware that we can do better. We want to do better. There are some things that we need to keep doing well, other things that we will improve for sure.’
news.body_zh: 哈维·阿隆索强调了他的切尔西后卫建立牢固合作伙伴关系的重要性，蓝军主教练在我们前往阿森纳之前强调了列维·科尔威尔和马克森斯·拉克鲁瓦的互补能力。两位中后卫正处于切尔西职业生涯的不同阶段。科尔威尔从我们的青训学院毕业后长期以来一直是斯坦福桥的一员，而拉克鲁瓦今年夏天从水晶宫加盟了蓝军。到目前为止，这两人一直是阿隆索防守的支柱，在我们的两场英超比赛中首发，我们在赛季开始时就连续战胜了富勒姆和布莱顿。在另一项艰巨的挑战——周日客场前往酋长球场——之前，我们的主教练讨论了两名中后卫的优势以及拉克鲁瓦对新球队的即时适应。 “我们需要保持良好的平衡，当然我们知道列维的最佳品质——他对我们的组织建设很重要，”阿隆索说。 “更多的是在左路，而不是在边路，当他有不同的对角线传球时，他能够看到，他能够找到口袋里的球员并看到另一个[右口袋]。但我们需要在防守方面建立良好的伙伴关系。 “马克斯森斯非常稳定，他很强壮，他在个性和意识方面与比赛的联系非常紧密，我们有希望产生这种影响的球员。这很好。马森斯来到这里才三、四个星期，但他已经真正融入了球队。阿隆索还讨论了他如何塑造切尔西球队，强调灵活性和敏锐性，以确保蓝军能够克服本赛季将面临的各种挑战。 “我们想要的是我们能够适应，”他说。 “肯定会有一些比赛，我们拥有很多控球权，但面对低位防守的球队时很难得分。 “但是拥有不同的工具，有不同的想法以及不同的方法，都是好的。 “我们还处于早期阶段。我们已经打了两场比赛，两场胜利，但我们知道我们可以做得更好。我们想要做得更好。有些事情我们需要继续做好，其他事情我们肯定会改进。

news.title: Key talking points from Sonia Bompastor's pre-Aston Villa press conference
news.title_zh: 索尼娅·邦帕斯特在阿斯顿维拉赛前新闻发布会上的主要谈话要点
news.body_en: Sonia Bompastor faced the media at Cobham ahead of our first Women's Super League match of the season on Saturday against Aston Villa. Here are the key takeaways from the Blues head coach's press conference... There was plenty to discuss following the news that Erin Cuthbert has been appointed Chelsea club captain – and will be supported by Nathalie Bjorn and Lucy Bronze – and the UEFA Women's Champions League league phase draw. During our European campaign, Bompastor will return to face her former side Lyon for the first time since leaving for Chelsea in 2024. But her priority is Aston Villa as our WSL campaign gets underway at our new home: Stamford Bridge. Here's everything you need to know ahead of that clash. Bompastor: 'Erin was probably the most natural player to become the captain after Millie Bright, which is not an easy task because Millie did a fantastic job for the club. 'When you talk about the badge, Erin is so passionate. She loves the club. She's so committed to the project, and she leads by example. She works hard and she has the right mindset and mentality. So for me, it was always obvious Erin was the natural captain. 'But it's also important to have the right support around Erin. It's really difficult at a club like Chelsea to only have one person who leads everything. So we worked a lot in pre-season around the leadership group, but also the two vice-captains, Nat and Lucy. 'We are in a good place in terms of the way we want to set up the processes between the coach, the captains and the leadership group, and I think that's important.' 'To be honest, I'm really excited, and I'm not the only one. Some players in the squad also played for Lyon, so it will be good for many of us. They have a great stadium, and they are a really good club. I will probably have many friends and family coming to the game, so it will be a special one for me. 'The most important thing is to focus on the team; that's the reality. As much as I am excited to go back to Lyon, we need to focus on how we can go there and win the game. 'The opportunity to start our season at Stamford Bridge is big and something we are all excited about. We can't wait to be in the game tomorrow, and hopefully we'll have a strong start and play a good game as well. 'Stamford Bridge is one of the best stadiums I've ever played in or managed in. We are really grateful to be able to do that for all the WSL games. We want to make sure we are a really difficult team to beat at home, and we want to create even more memories. 'It will be ideal if Stamford Bridge can become a fortress, so that’s what we are aiming for.' 'I think this league is already the most competitive in the world, and it's becoming stronger and stronger each season. Many teams are now investing in their women's team; I think that's good. 'I came into this league because I wanted to be challenged as a manager. The players also want to play in the best league. Every game is so difficult. The expectation this season is no different, but I think it will become even more difficult. I'm really excited for that. 'We want to embrace the challenge, and we know this season won't be easy for anyone, including us. We have enough quality in this squad, in this team, that if we have the right mentality, the right mindset, and we keep working hard as we did during pre-season, we can be ambitious.
news.body_zh: 周六，我们本赛季第一场女足超级联赛对阵阿斯顿维拉，索尼娅·邦帕斯特在科巴姆接受了媒体采访。以下是蓝军主教练新闻发布会的主要内容……在艾琳·库斯伯特被任命为切尔西俱乐部队长（并将得到娜塔莉·比约恩和露西·青铜的支持）以及欧足联女子冠军联赛阶段抽签的消息传出后，有很多值得讨论的内容。在我们的欧洲赛事期间，邦帕斯托将自 2024 年转会切尔西以来首次回归，面对她的前东家里昂。但她的首要任务是阿斯顿维拉，因为我们的 WSL 赛季将在我们的新主场：斯坦福桥开始。以下是您在这场冲突之前需要了解的所有信息。 Bompastor：“艾琳可能是继米莉·布莱特之后最自然成为队长的球员，这不是一件容易的事，因为米莉为俱乐部做了出色的工作。 “当你谈论徽章时，艾琳非常热情。她热爱俱乐部。她非常致力于这个项目，并且以身作则。她工作努力，有正确的心态和心态。所以对我来说，很明显艾琳是天生的队长。 “但在艾琳周围获得正确的支持也很重要。在切尔西这样的俱乐部，只有一个人领导一切真的很困难。因此，我们在季前赛中围绕领导团队以及两位副队长纳特和露西进行了大量工作。 “我们在教练、队长和领导小组之间建立流程方面处于有利位置，我认为这很重要。” “说实话，我真的很兴奋，而且我不是唯一一个。队中的一些球员也曾为里昂效力，所以这对我们很多人来说都是好事。他们有一个很棒的体育场，他们是一家非常好的俱乐部。我可能会有很多朋友和家人来看比赛，所以这对我来说将是一场特别的比赛。 “最重要的是专注于团队；这就是现实。尽管我很高兴回到里昂，但我们需要专注于如何去那里赢得比赛。 “在斯坦福桥开始我们的赛季的机会很大，我们都对此感到兴奋。我们迫不及待地想参加明天的比赛，希望我们能有一个良好的开局并打出一场精彩的比赛。 “斯坦福桥是我曾经效力过或管理过的最好的体育场之一。我们真的很感激能够在所有 WSL 比赛中做到这一点。我们想要确保我们是一支在主场很难击败的球队，我们想要创造更多的回忆。 “如果斯坦福桥能够成为一座堡垒，那就太理想了，这就是我们的目标。” “我认为这个联赛已经是世界上最具竞争力的联赛，而且每个赛季都在变得越来越强大。许多球队现在都在投资女队；我认为这很好。 “我进入这个联盟是因为我想作为一名教练接受挑战。球员们也想在最好的联赛中踢球。每场比赛都那么困难。本赛季的期望没有什么不同，但我认为这会变得更加困难。我对此感到非常兴奋。 “我们想要迎接挑战，我们知道这个赛季对任何人来说都不容易，包括我们。我们在这支球队中拥有足够的素质，如果我们有正确的心态，正确的心态，并且我们像季前赛期间那样继续努力，我们就可以雄心勃勃。

news.title: Chelsea Women squad numbers confirmed for the 2026/27 season
news.title_zh: 切尔西女足 2026/27 赛季球员阵容确认
news.body_en:
The Chelsea Women squad numbers for the 2026/27 campaign have today been finalised.

 Blues defender Naomi Girma has inherited the No.4 shirt previously worn by former Blues captain and club legend Millie Bright. Meanwhile, Sandy Baltimore has chosen the No.11 shirt donned by Guro Reiten before her departure last season. Midfielder Wieke Kaptein will wear our No.19 shirt this season, while there is another change in the centre of the pitch with Keira Walsh selecting the No.21. Katie McCabe has taken our No.15 shirt after joining the Blues from Arsenal, while fellow new arrival Manaka Matsukubo will wear the No.29 this season. Summer signings Melvine Malard and Giulia Dragoni have chosen the nine and 16 shirts, respectively. Meanwhile, Nelly Las will wear our No.17.

news.title: PGA South League report: Southampton Women Under-21s 0-4 Chelsea Women Under-18s
news.title_zh: PGA 南联盟报告：南安普顿 21 岁以下女子队 0-4 切尔西 18 岁以下女子队
news.body_en: Chelsea Women’s Under-18s continued their impressive start to the Professional Game Academy South League campaign, securing a 4-0 victory away at Southampton Under-21s on Wednesday afternoon. Chelsea Women's Under-18s, who play in the PGA Under-21 Women's League, were ahead after 37 minutes through Annie Boichat and established a two-goal advantage shortly after the interval thanks to Aysia Matabaro's strike. Rebekah Pierce and Jahmya Putman added further goals in the second half as Chelsea secured a third successive league victory. The Blues showed a positive attitude and desire to remain organised throughout, working hard for the full 90 minutes to overcome a difficult Southampton side during a busy period of fixtures. Chelsea made a positive start and moved in front after 37 minutes. A corner from the right was delivered into the Southampton box by Sadie Gregory, causing disruption in the six-yard area. Boichat made a powerful run into the box and met the delivery with a well-struck header to give the Blues the lead. Chelsea continued to work hard and remain organised for the remainder of the first half, taking a deserved one-goal advantage into the interval. The Blues doubled their advantage two minutes into the second half following some good work to regain possession. Carla Gardiner applied pressure to a backwards pass following a Southampton throw-in, with Putman also involved in pressing to win the ball. Putman then drove forward down the left before finding Pierce on the edge of the box. Pierce switched play to Matabaro, who showed good footwork to take the ball beyond the Southampton full-back before firing a powerful low shot past the goalkeeper. Chelsea continued to move the ball with purpose, and a third goal arrived on 63 minutes. Elise Christian and Keira Johnson combined well down the left to circulate possession around the box, creating space with positive speed of play and patience. Putman attempted to spin her defender and shoot, but her effort was blocked. Pierce was well placed to regain possession and, after taking a few close touches to unbalance her opponent, rolled her defender before shooting from just outside the area. Her powerful left-footed effort dipped underneath the bar to extend Chelsea's lead. There was still time for one more as Chelsea added a fourth five minutes from time. Quick ball movement and fluid rotations created space for the Blues to attack down the right through Maisie Brickell, Tess Finn and Zoe Ciccardini. Ciccardini looked to find Matabaro's run beyond the defensive line, but Southampton recovered and played the ball back towards their goalkeeper. Good pressure from Gardiner and Matabaro then forced another regain. Matabaro's initial effort was saved by the Southampton goalkeeper, but Putman was well positioned to capitalise and finish first time. The result means Chelsea Women Under-18s have taken maximum points from their opening three Professional Game Academy South League matches, with nine points and a strong goal difference. Chelsea's next fixture sees us travel to face Swindon Town in the Women's National League Cup on Sunday. Chelsea Women Under-18s (4-3-3): Bella Bartlett; Elise Christian, Sadie Gregory (Emelia Addison 64’), Annie Boichat (Maisie Brickell 45’), Zoe Ciccardini; Tess Finn, Belle Sullivan (c) (Kiera Johnson 45’), Stevie Sinclair (Rebekah Pierce 45’); Jahmya Putman, Chelsea N’Drin (Carla Gardiner 45’), Aysia Matabaro. Scorers: Boichat 37; Matabaro 47; Pierce 63; Putman 85
news.body_zh: 切尔西女子 18 岁以下队继续在职业比赛学院南联赛中取得令人印象深刻的开局，周三下午客场 4-0 战胜南安普顿 21 岁以下队。参加 PGA 21 岁以下女子联赛的切尔西 18 岁以下女子队在第 37 分钟通过安妮·博伊查特 (Annie Boichat) 取得领先，并在中场休息后不久凭借艾西亚·马塔巴罗 (Aysia Matabaro) 的进球确立了两球优势。丽贝卡·皮尔斯和贾米亚·普特曼在下半场进一步进球，帮助切尔西取得联赛三连胜。蓝军表现出了积极的态度和自始至终保持组织性的愿望，在整个90分钟的努力中，在繁忙的赛程中克服了困难的南安普顿队。切尔西开局积极，第 37 分钟就取得领先。萨迪·格雷戈里将右侧角球送入南安普顿禁区，造成六码区域的混乱。博伊查特大力冲入禁区，头球攻门帮助蓝军取得领先。切尔西在上半场剩余时间里继续努力，保持组织有序，在中场休息时取得了当之无愧的一球优势。下半场两分钟后，蓝军通过出色的表现重新夺回控球权，将优势扩大一倍。卡拉·加德纳（Carla Gardiner）在南安普顿队掷界外球后对向后传球施加压力，普特曼（Putman）也参与了压制以赢得球权。普特曼随后从左侧向前推进，然后在禁区边缘找到了皮尔斯。皮尔斯将比赛换给了马塔巴罗，马塔巴罗表现出了良好的步法，将球带过南安普顿队的后卫，然后一记强力低射越过了门将。切尔西继续有目的地转移球，并在第 63 分钟打入第三个进球。埃莉斯·克里斯蒂安（Elise Christian）和凯拉·约翰逊（Keira Johnson）在左路联手，在禁区周围循环控球，以积极的速度和耐心创造空间。普特曼试图旋转防守球员并射门，但她的射门被挡住了。皮尔斯处于有利位置，重新夺回控球权，在几次近距离触球使对手失去平衡后，他滚开防守球员，然后从禁区外射门。她有力的左脚射门击中横梁，扩大了切尔西的领先优势。距离比赛结束还剩五分钟，切尔西又打进了第四球。快速的球移动和流畅的旋转为蓝军通过梅西·布里克尔、泰丝·芬恩和佐伊·西卡迪尼的右路进攻创造了空间。西卡迪尼试图寻找马塔巴罗冲出防线的机会，但南安普顿队恢复过来，将球回传给他们的门将。加德纳和马塔巴罗的强大压力迫使球队再次扳回一球。马塔巴罗的最初射门被南安普顿门将扑出，但普特曼处于有利位置，首次进球。这一结果意味着切尔西 18 岁以下女子队在职业比赛学院南联赛的前三场比赛中获得了最高分，积 9 分并拥有强大的净胜球优势。切尔西的下一场比赛我们将在周日的女子全国联赛杯中对阵斯温顿镇。切尔西 18 岁以下女子队 (4-3-3)：贝拉·巴特利特； Elise Christian、Sadie Gregory (Emelia Addison 64’)、Annie Boichat (Maisie Brickell 45’)、Zoe Ciccardini；泰丝·芬恩 (Tess Finn)、贝尔·沙利文 (Belle Sullivan) (c)（基拉·约翰逊 45’）、史蒂维·辛克莱 (Rebekah Pierce 45’)；贾米亚·普特曼、切尔西·恩德林（卡拉·加德纳 45 分钟）、艾西亚·马塔巴罗。进球者：Boichat 37；马塔巴罗 47；皮尔斯 63；普特曼85

news.title: New programme for a new era of Chelsea Women at Stamford Bridge
news.title_zh: 斯坦福桥切尔西女足新时代的新计划
news.body_en: It is a new era for Chelsea Women as we make Stamford Bridge our home for all Women's Super League fixtures and to mark the occasion you won’t want to miss our bigger, better, new-look CFCW matchday programme tomorrow. With a dedicated Junior Blues section, including a pull-out poster, plus all your regular interview features and match info, there is something for everyone inside, not to mention exclusive columns from Sonia Bompastor and new captain Erin Cuthbert. Each programme is numbered for you to complete the 2026/27 collection, and in this issue you can read an exclusive interview with Giulia Dragoni, who discusses her outlook on the game. 'I like to create, I like to take risks, I like to let people enjoy football,' she says. 'Hopefully they can enjoy watching us play. 'I’m so excited. I’m really working hard and looking forward to the first game, and to make my debut. I think the WSL is the most competitive league in the world, so it’s an honour and a privilege to be able to compete in it.' Meanwhile, Melvine Malard picks out some cherished memories in our Firsts & Favs series, and we grant readers behind-the-scenes access from our trip to San Sebastian in our Sneak Peak section. With quizzes, games and your chance to be the matchday reporter, there is more reason than ever to pick up the CFCW programme. Make sure you get your copy from the programme sellers around Stamford Bridge!
news.body_zh: 对于切尔西女足来说，这是一个新时代，我们将斯坦福桥作为所有女足超级联赛比赛的主场，以纪念您不想错过明天我们更大、更好、全新的 CFCW 比赛日计划的时刻。专门的青少年蓝调部分，包括一张拉出海报，以及所有定期采访专题和比赛信息，里面有适合每个人的内容，更不用说 Sonia Bompastor 和新队长 Erin Cuthbert 的独家专栏。每个节目都经过编号，供您完成 2026/27 年系列，在本期中您可以阅读 Giulia Dragoni 的独家专访，她讨论了她对游戏的看法。 “我喜欢创造，喜欢冒险，喜欢让人们享受足球，”她说。 “希望他们能喜欢看我们比赛。 '我太激动了。我真的很努力，期待着第一场比赛，期待着我的首秀。我认为 WSL 是世界上最具竞争力的联赛，因此能够参加其中是一种荣幸。”与此同时，梅尔文·马拉德 (Melvine Malard) 在我们的“第一次和最爱”系列中挑选了一些珍贵的回忆，我们在“抢先体验”部分为读者提供了圣塞巴斯蒂安之旅的幕后花絮。通过测验、游戏以及成为比赛日记者的机会，您比以往更有理由收听 CFCW 节目。确保您从斯坦福桥周边的节目销售商那里获得了副本！

news.title: Emi Martinez changes Chelsea squad number
news.title_zh: 埃米·马丁内斯改变切尔西队号码
news.body_en: Emiliano Martinez has switched to the No.1 shirt for Chelsea. Our summer signing originally took the No.26 shirt for the Blues and wore it in our 4-3 victory over Brighton & Hove Albion at Stamford Bridge. However, due to Robert Sanchez’s loan move to Como, the No.1 shirt has since become vacant and our Argentinian international has opted to take that number. In recognition of the change, and those impacted, Emi has kindly offered to sign all “Martinez 26” shirts that had been obtained via the official Club Megastore or official Club website. In order to arrange this, supporters will be required to bring this shirt to Stamford Bridge along with proof of purchase by October 4. The 2026/27 Nike home shirt is now on sale to fans with early access via our Megastore at Stamford Bridge and our online store.
news.body_zh: 埃米利亚诺·马丁内斯 (Emiliano Martinez) 换上了切尔西的 1 号球衣。我们的夏季签约球员最初为蓝军穿上了 26 号球衣，并在斯坦福桥 4-3 战胜布莱顿的比赛中穿着这件球衣。然而，由于罗伯特·桑切斯租借到科莫，1号球衣从此空缺，我们的阿根廷国脚选择了这个号码。为了认识到这一变化以及受到影响的人们，Emi 善意地提出在通过俱乐部官方大商店或俱乐部官方网站获得的所有“Martinez 26”衬衫上签名。为了安排这一活动，球迷们需要在 10 月 4 日之前将这件球衣连同购买证明一起带到斯坦福桥。2026/27 赛季 Nike 主场球衣现已向球迷发售，可以通过我们位于斯坦福桥的 Megastore 和我们的在线商店抢先购买。

news.title: Sonia Bompastor gives update on Mayra Ramirez and Manaka Matsukubo availability
news.title_zh: Sonia Bompastor 更新了 Mayra Ramirez 和 Manaka Matsukubo 的可用性
news.body_en: Sonia Bompastor explained that striker Mayra Ramirez and new signing Manaka Matsukubo will miss our clash with Aston Villa on Saturday lunch time as we look to begin our domestic campaign with a victory. We will play all of our Women's Super League games at Stamford Bridge this season, as the match against the Villans marks the beginning of our new era in SW6. Bompastor will be without Ramirez for Saturday's match and our head coach gave the latest on the Colombian forward's availability. 'Mayra is not available for the game tomorrow, but she didn't play for a full season last season, so she needs time to build up. We are taking the time she needs to be in the best place possible. We'll see how she's performing and building up, but she's not ready for tomorrow.' 'I think if you watch all the teams in the men's and women's game, the strongest sides need to have a lot of quality and talent in the squad. Mayra is one of the most talented No9s in the world, but with many games to play, it's always better for the manager to have many options and to have everyone available. 'We'll try to do our best for her to be available soon. In the interim, we'll have other options.' Meanwhile, Japan international Matsukubo signed for Chelsea in the summer but is yet to make her Blues debut. Bompastor explained why she was so keen to bring her into the club, and gave the latest on when fans might see her in action. 'She's a great player,' continued our head coach. 'She's so smart, really comfortable on the ball. We were really looking for a player who can bring a lot of creativity in our midfield. I think that's what she can bring to us. 'For now, she's not available, but I'm hoping for her to be available soon because I think she will be a really important player for us. In this league, she will be one of the best.'
news.body_zh: 索尼娅·邦帕斯托解释说，前锋迈拉·拉米雷斯和新加盟的松久保真中将缺席周六午餐时间与阿斯顿维拉的比赛，因为我们希望以一场胜利开始我们的国内联赛。本赛季我们所有的女足超级联赛比赛都将在斯坦福桥进行，因为对阵维拉队的比赛标志着我们在 SW6 新时代的开始。庞帕斯托将缺席拉米雷斯周六的比赛，我们的主教练提供了这位哥伦比亚前锋上场的最新消息。 “梅拉无法参加明天的比赛，但她上赛季没有打满整个赛季，所以她需要时间来恢复。我们正在花时间让她处于尽可能最好的位置。我们会看看她的表现和恢复情况如何，但她还没有为明天做好准备。” “我认为，如果你观察男子和女子比赛中的所有球队，最强的球队需要在阵容中拥有大量的素质和天赋。梅拉是世界上最有才华的九号球员之一，但由于要踢很多比赛，对于主教练来说，拥有更多选择并让每个人都能上场总是更好。 “我们会尽力让她尽快康复。在此期间，我们将有其他选择。与此同时，日本国脚松久保在夏天签约切尔西，但尚未完成她的蓝军首秀。邦帕斯托解释了为什么她如此热衷于带她加入俱乐部，并提供了球迷何时可能看到她比赛的最新消息。 “她是一位出色的球员，”我们的主教练继续说道。 “她非常聪明，在球上非常自如。我们确实在寻找一位能够为我们的中场带来大量创造力的球员。我想这就是她能给我们带来的东西。 “目前，她还不能上场，但我希望她很快就能上场，因为我认为她对我们来说将是一名非常重要的球员。在这个联盟中，她将是最好的之一。

news.title: Confirmed Chelsea team news ahead of Arsenal
news.title_zh: 在阿森纳之前确认了切尔西队的消息
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso says a final decision on Moises Caicedo's fitness will be taken tomorrow (Saturday) when the Blues manager selects his squad for our London derby against Arsenal. The Ecuadorian international was absent for our opening two fixtures of the season – a Premier League win over Fulham and a Carabao Cup victory over Luton Town – but returned to the squad last weekend as we faced Brighton and Hove Albion. Caicedo was introduced as a second-half substitute against the Seagulls, but was forced off after just 13 minutes with what Alonso described as an issue that 'wasn't something new'. In his pre-match press conference ahead of Sunday's trip to the Emirates Stadium, Alonso was asked whether Caicedo would be involved. He replied: 'We will check tomorrow. Tomorrow is the last decision for the squad on Sunday. 'We need to not be worried. These things can happen and we need to check. Tomorrow we will make the final decision.' Alonso also discussed another player who has missed the start of the season, striker Emmanuel Emegha. After arriving from Strasbourg in the summer, an injury sustained in pre-season has delayed the Netherlands international's Chelsea bow. However, Alonso insists Emegha will get his chance once he returns to full fitness, and is excited about what the forward can add to the team. 'I see him playing on the last line, and when he has space he is a big threat,' Alonso added. 'He has been here for a few months and had an injury that meant he missed part of pre-season, unfortunately for him. But he’s young, and he has very special qualities. 'We hope that he feels better and he takes those steps so that he’s going to be more involved. Players that are young and come here need to be patient, but knowing that for sure they will have their opportunity.'
news.body_zh: 哈比·阿隆索表示，关于莫伊塞斯·凯塞多的健康状况的最终决定将于明天（周六）做出，届时蓝军主教练将选择他的阵容参加我们对阵阿森纳的伦敦德比。这位厄瓜多尔国脚缺席了我们本赛季的前两场比赛——英超联赛战胜富勒姆和卡拉宝杯战胜卢顿镇——但上周末我们对阵布莱顿和霍夫阿尔比恩时，他回到了球队。凯塞多在对阵海鸥队的下半场替补上场，但仅仅 13 分钟后就被迫下场，阿隆索称这个问题“不是什么新鲜事”。在周日前往酋长球场之前的赛前新闻发布会上，阿隆索被问及凯塞多是否会参与其中。他回答说：“我们明天会检查。”明天是周日球队的最后决定。 “我们不必担心。这些事情可能会发生，我们需要检查。明天我们将做出最终决定。阿隆索还讨论了另一位缺席赛季初的球员，前锋伊曼纽尔·埃梅加。夏天从斯特拉斯堡抵达后，季前赛中受伤导致这位荷兰国脚推迟了切尔西的出场时间。然而，阿隆索坚持认为，一旦埃梅加完全恢复健康，他就会得到机会，并对这位前锋能为球队带来的帮助感到兴奋。 “我看到他在最后防线打球，当他有空间时，他就是一个很大的威胁，”阿隆索补充道。 “他已经在这里呆了几个月了，受伤意味着他错过了部分季前赛，这对他来说很不幸。但他很年轻，而且有很特别的品质。 “我们希望他感觉好一些，并采取这些措施，以便他能够更多地参与其中。来到这里的年轻球员需要耐心，但他们知道他们肯定会有机会。”

news.title: Premier League ticket news: Bournemouth at home

news.body_en: The information on how tickets will be sold for our first home game next month have been released. Chelsea host our Premier League meeting with the Cherries at Stamford Bridge on Saturday 10 October, kick-off 3pm. Home tickets for members for men’s team matches are now allocated through a new application process. For each home match, eligible members have a designated application window during which they can apply for tickets. Applications can be made individually or as a group, provided all members of the group are eligible to apply during that window. Tickets will be allocated one per person with a maximum of four per application. Ticket application window opens – Monday 7 September 12pm Ticket application window closes – Thursday 10 September 12pm The ticket application window will be open for True Blue+, True Blue, CFC Blue, and Junior Blue members. As part of the verification process, a pre-authorisation charge £0.01 will be applied to validate your payment card. No money will be taken at this stage, and the hold will be removed by your provider. Tickets for this match are priced at Category A. Please click here for match ticket prices Tickets will appear on the Chelsea Official App prior to the event. Eligible members can submit their application through the ticketing portal at any time during the window, supporters must ensure they are logged in to successfully apply. Applying earlier does not increase the likelihood of success, giving supporters greater flexibility to apply at a time that suits them. As part of the new ticket sales process, members who are eligible for concession-rate tickets are automatically assigned their price class. To ensure you are receiving the correct ticket, please take the time to check the date of birth on your account is accurate. You will only be allocated tickets in your selected areas unless you choose to be considered for other available options. If you only wish to be entered for tickets in one area of the stadium, please leave the second option blank. Please read the ticket application information carefully before submitting your application. Successful and unsuccessful applications will be notified by email within four working days of the ticket application window closing date. Successful applications will be charged to their payment card approximately at this time. Supporters are not able to use account credit for ticket application window purchases. Tickets are for Chelsea supporters only. All persons under the age of 16 will be required to attend with and sit next to a person aged 18 years of age or over. Members and season ticket holders can purchase Westview tickets for Premier League home games via the Chelsea FC Official Ticketing Portal. A maximum of four tickets can be bought per person, and only the ticket purchaser is required to be a member or season ticket holder. You are not required to be a member or season ticket holder to purchase non-Westview Club Chelsea packages. Club Chelsea tickets are non-refundable unless the match is cancelled, postponed, or moved more than 48 hours either side of the scheduled fixture date. All Club Chelsea ticket purchases are subject to Club Chelsea terms and conditions. For any further Westview enquiries, please email clubchelsea@chelseafc.com. Loyalty points will now only be awarded for attendance at men’s first-team home matches and no longer accrued for purchasing tickets. Points will be added to eligible accounts following each game, provided the ticket has been scanned at the turnstile. This means that supporters purchasing tickets on the ticket exchange, or receiving tickets via ticket forwarding, will now receive loyalty points for attending matches. Supporters will receive three loyalty points for attending this match. Points will be applied after the fixture has been played. Members can still purchase general admission tickets if available in line with the General Admission Policy. Supporters who require accessible tickets can apply through the accessible ticket application window. Timings are below: Accessible ticket application window opens - Monday 7 September 12pm Accessible ticket application window closes – Thursday 10 September 12pm Supporters, if they are able to do so, can call our Access Team during opening hours on 0371 811 2012 or 0044 207 915 1950 (international callers) for any questions or if they need further information. Personal assistant tickets can be submitted during this ticket application window. Supporters can apply for car parking by clicking here from Tuesday 15 September. You are required to display your Blue Badge while parked at Stamford Bridge. In addition to season ticket holders, True Blue+, True Blue and CFC Blue members now have the option to list tickets on the ticket exchange if they are unable to attend a home match. Supporters can access the ticket exchange through the Official Ticketing Portal. The sales information on the Buy Tickets page will be updated once the ticket exchange is open. The ticket exchange will close three hours before kick-off, unless stated otherwise. Those unsuccessful in the ticket application window will have a ticket exchange priority window. Once open, season ticket holders and members can send and receive tickets up until three hours before kick-off. Please note that those who have forwarded their ticket will not be able to list their ticket on the ticket exchange. Click for ticket forwarding FAQs Match and ticket application window dates are subject to change. All ticket sales are subject to availability. Please check the website for the latest information.

news.title: Chelsea Women vice-captains confirmed
news.title_zh: 切尔西女足副队长确认
news.body_en: After Erin Cuthbert was announced as Chelsea Women's new club captain, we can now reveal the two players who will support her as vice-captains. Cuthbert, who has been at Chelsea for over 10 years, has taken the armband following the retirement of former skipper Millie Bright in April last year. She will be supported by Nathalie Bjorn and Lucy Bronze, who have both been named as Chelsea vice-captains ahead of the first Women's Super League match of the season against Aston Villa at Stamford Bridge on Saturday. Bjorn has made 56 appearances for Chelsea since joining the club midway through the 2023/24 campaign. An experienced and commanding central defender, the 29-year-old has also earned 82 senior caps for Sweden. During her time at Chelsea, she has lifted two Women's Super League titles, one Women's FA Cup and two Women's League Cup trophies. Bronze is one of the most experienced players in the women's game. The 34-year-old has lifted two Women's Euro trophies with England and made the World Cup final with the Lionesses in 2023. Having played for clubs at home and across Europe, Bronze joined Chelsea at the start of the domestic Treble-winning campaign of 2024/25 and has since made 58 appearances for the Blues. Congratulations, Nathalie and Lucy!

news.body_en: The six clubs Chelsea will face in the league phase of this season’s UEFA Women's Champions League have been confirmed. We will face six different teams in the league phase, hosting three matches at Plough Lane and travelling to three others across the continent. The league phase format dictates that the top four teams will progress straight to the quarter-finals. The teams finishing between fifth and 12th place will take part in the knockout play-offs, deciding the last four quarter-final spots. Teams finishing 13th and below will exit the competition. The draw took place in Nyon, Switzerland, and the Blues’ UEFA coefficient ranking ensured we took our place in Pot 1. And after being the second club drawn from Pot 1, our path was set by the automated software… Paris Saint-Germain (H)Lyonnes (A)Roma (H)Hacken (A)Austria Vienna (H)Leuven (A) The precise fixture list will be announced on Saturday 5 September, but the provisional dates for the six league-phase matchdays are as follows: Matchday one: 22-23 SeptemberMatchday two: 30 September-1 OctoberMatchday three: 28-29 OctoberMatchday four: 10-11 NovemberMatchday five: 18-19 NovemberMatchday six: 16 December Season ticket holders and Bridge Pass holders will be able to purchase Women's Champions League tickets on Monday 7 September from 2pm, with general sale opening at 2pm on Tuesday 8 September, subject to fixture confirmation from UEFA.

news.title: Summer transfers 2026: All the Chelsea Women ins, outs and new contracts so far
news.title_zh: 2026 年夏季转会：迄今为止切尔西女足的所有进场、出局和新合同
news.body_en: With the 2026 Women's Super League summer transfer window now closed, here's a summary of all the deals done so far this summer... Giulia Dragoni completed a permanent transfer from Barcelona to Chelsea. The Italy international, regarded as one of the best young midfielders in world football, signed a four-year contract with the Blues. England youth international Nelly Las joined from Leicester City on a four-year contract. The 18-year-old is an attacking full-back who can play on both sides and is also capable of featuring as a wing-back. The 30-year-old Republic of Ireland captain joined from Arsenal, signing a contract with Chelsea until 30 June 2029, with the option for an additional year. Malard is regarded as one of the most dangerous forwards in the game and signed for Chelsea on a four-year contract after making the move from Manchester United. Matsukubo joined Chelsea on a five-year deal from North Carolina Courage. Widely regarded as one of the most talented young players in world football, the Japanese international was named the NWSL Midfielder of the Year last season. Sandy Baltimore has signed a contract extension at the club until the summer of 2030. The 26-year-old joined the Blues from Paris Saint-Germain ahead of the 2024/25 campaign. We would go on to win an unbeaten domestic Treble that season and her performance in the Women’s FA Cup final stood out in particular as she scored twice in our 3-0 win over Manchester United. Homegrown star Aggie Beever-Jones signed a new contract with Chelsea until 2030. A product of our Academy, which she joined at nine years old, Beever-Jones has established herself as a key figure in the first-team squad and an England international over the past three seasons. Lucy Bronze signed a contract extension with Chelsea until the summer of 2027. One of the most experienced and highly decorated players in the women’s game, the defender first signed for the Blues from Barcelona ahead of the 2024/25 campaign. The youngster put pen to paper on a new contract, committing her future to the club until at least 2029. Brown joined Chelsea during the 2019/20 season and agreed her first professional contract in November 2024, aged 17. Goalkeeper Katie Cox committed her future to Chelsea by signing a new three-year contract, and has been with the Blues since the age of eight. Hannah Hampton committed her future to Chelsea by signing a new two-year contract with the club. Since signing for the Blues from Aston Villa three years ago, Hampton has won five trophies with Chelsea, starred for England as the Lionesses retained their European title and was awarded the Yashin Trophy at the Ballon d’Or ceremony in 2025, recognising her as the best goalkeeper in the world over the previous year. Eva Hendle signed her first professional contract with Chelsea until the summer of 2028, with the option of a further year. The midfielder signed a new contract at Chelsea, committing her future to the club until at least 2029. Having joined the Blues in the summer of 2024, the 18-year-old agreed her first professional contract with us in February of last year. Academy striker Lois Shooter has signed her first professional contract with the club until the summer of 2028. Having previously been part of the London City Lionesses’ youth system, Shooter joined the Chelsea Academy at the age of 15. Goalkeeper Becky Spencer will remain with Chelsea for a further year after an option to extend her contract was exercised. The Jamaica international spent the last three months of the domestic Treble-winning 2024/25 season with the Blues after initially joining on loan from Tottenham Hotspur in March 2025. Forward Mara Alber will spend the 2026/27 campaign on loan at German club Wolfsburg. The 20-year-old joined the Blues in the summer of 2025 from Hoffenheim and spent the second half of last season on loan at Werder Bremen. Cox will head out on loan to Nottingham Forest for the 2026/27 season, following last season's loan at Aberdeen. There, she quickly established herself as first choice between the posts, featuring in 23 of their 26 league fixtures. Eva Hendle joined Rangers on loan for the 2026/27 season after having agreed her first professional contract with Chelsea this summer. Hendle joined the Chelsea Academy aged 12, having previously played in the London City Lionesses youth system. Vera Jones completed a season-long loan to Women’s Super League 2 side Watford, having spent last season with Bristol City, playing 22 times. Chelsea goalkeeper Femke Liefting will spend this season on loan at Ajax. The young goalkeeper joined Chelsea in January 2025, signing on a three-and-a-half-year deal from Dutch side AZ Alkmaar. Louna Ribadeira will spend a further season on loan at FC Fleury 91 in the French top-flight in 2026/27. She also spent last season on loan at the French club to support her return to football following a prolonged period out with injury. Having signed her first professional contract with Chelsea, Lois Shooter will spend next season on loan at WSL 2 side Nottingham Forest alongside Blues team-mate Katie Cox. Brooke Aspin joined Bristol City on a permanent transfer. The centre-back came through the Bristol City youth programme and signed for Chelsea shortly after her 18th birthday ahead of the 2023/24 season. Julia Bartel joined Juventus on a permanent transfer. Bartel joined the Blues from Barcelona in the summer of 2024 and made her Chelsea debut in October that year, coming on as a second-half substitute against Twente in the UEFA Women’s Champions League group stage. Niamh Charles completed a permanent transfer to Manchester City, bringing a trophy-laden six-year spell at Chelsea to an end. Charles left the Blues having won five WSL titles, four FA Cups and three League Cups. She played 178 games for us and scored 13 goals. Jorja Fox completed a permanent move to Ipswich Town, having joined the Chelsea Academy at the age of eight, and made her senior debut for the Blues in a 4-0 away victory against Aston Villa in the 2020/21 campaign. Johanna Rytting Kaneryd left Chelsea to join French side Lyonnes on a permanent deal. The Sweden international spent four successful seasons with the Blues after arriving from Hacken in 2022. Rytting Kaneryd played 139 times for us, scoring 17 goals, registering 26 assists and lifting seven major trophies.

NWSL 年度最佳中场球员。桑迪·巴尔的摩与俱乐部续约至 2030 年夏天。这位 26 岁的球员在 2024/25 赛季之前从巴黎圣日耳曼加盟蓝军。那个赛季我们以不败的成绩赢得了国内三冠王，她在女子足总杯决赛中的表现尤其出色，在我们3-0战胜曼联的比赛中梅开二度。本土球星阿吉·比弗-琼斯与切尔西签订了一份到 2030 月与我们签订了她的第一份职业合同。青训前锋路易斯·舒特与俱乐部签订了她的第一份职业合同，合同期至 2028 年夏天。舒特曾是伦敦城狮队青训系统的一员，15 岁时加入切尔西青训学院。门将贝基·斯宾塞在行使续约选择权后，将在切尔西再留一年。这位牙买加国脚在2025年3月从托特纳姆热刺租借加盟后，在蓝军度过了2024/25赛季国内三冠王的最后三个月。前锋马拉·阿尔伯将在2026/27赛季租借到德国俱乐部沃尔夫斯堡。这位20岁的球员于2025年夏天从霍芬海姆加盟蓝军，上赛季后半段被租借到云达不来梅。继上赛季租借至阿伯丁后，考克斯将在2026/27赛季租借至诺丁汉森林。在那里，她很快确立了自己作为首发球员的首选地位，并在 队效力一个赛季。上赛季她还被租借到法国俱乐部，以支持她在长期受伤后重返足球场。在与切尔西签订了第一份职业合同后，洛伊丝·射手下赛季将与蓝军队友凯蒂·考克斯一起租借到 WSL 2 球队诺丁汉森林队。布鲁克·阿斯平永久转会加盟布里斯托城。这位中后卫参加了布里斯托城青年队的训练，并在 18 岁生日后不久与切尔西签约，准备迎接 2023/24 赛季。朱莉娅·巴特尔永久转会加盟尤文图斯。巴特尔于 2024 news.title: An open letter to Chelsea supporters from captain Erin Cuthbert
news.title_zh: 队长艾琳·卡斯伯特致切尔西球迷的公开信
news.body_en: After being announced as our new club captain, Erin Cuthbert sat down to write a letter directly to you, the Blues supporters... I am so honoured to be named your club’s captain. There is a responsibility on my shoulders and I’m excited and looking forward to it. When I moved down at 18 as a young, naive little Scottish kid, I’d have never imagined I’d be where I am now, 10 years later. From the minute I walked in the door at Cobham, it felt like home. As soon as I wore the shirt for the first time, it just felt right. My team-mates, the staff and all the people who make this club tick on a daily basis – you instantly made me feel like I belonged here. I have so much respect for the captains who came before me, and I was so lucky to learn from them through the best part of 10 unprecedented years of this club’s history, and I’m forever grateful for each and every one of them who have taken the club to where it is now. I know the responsibility that comes with following the great captains who have led this club before me. And I’ll never take that lightly. Now we have the resources and infrastructure to ensure we can be the best we can be. It’s up to us as players to perform. I feel strongly about history and heritage; that’s when the foundation was laid for the club’s future success. That’s what Chelsea was built on, and it will continue to be as we go forward. It’s an exciting moment for the club. There are new players, new staff and, of course, a new home at Stamford Bridge. There are a lot of changes happening in the background, too – really positive changes that will help elevate the women’s team. I’m proud to be leading the team through it. I’m looking forward to what the future holds because we’ve got a great group, hungry to achieve success and, equally, a great team promoting the club behind the scenes. Everybody wants to make this club the best it can be. It’s hard to put into words how much you, the supporters, mean to me. Some of you have been part of my life for more than 10 years... I’ve seen you more than I’ve seen my family. You’ve had my back through some rough times, and you're a huge reason why we’ve had so much success. Celebrating each and every one of the 18 trophies won made moving away from home and my family worthwhile. I made my second family here. It feels like we’re bound together. It’s great to have you on the journey with us, and now we’re moving to Stamford Bridge, you deserve to reap the rewards as much as we do. I even remember some of your faces who followed us back in Staines when I joined all those years ago. You have travelled for games up and down the country and across Europe, some even just days before Christmas in the Champions League. You give us that extra yard, that extra bit of intensity. I don’t think you realise how much of a difference you make – Lyon at home in the Champions League, the Man City comeback. Those simply don’t happen without you. At Chelsea Women, we talk about being never done. To me, that means not giving up when it feels uncomfortable, fighting until the very end and finding a way to win. We want to keep growing. We want to win trophies. We want to see what this group is capable of together. Thank you for all your support on the journey so far – let’s continue making history together for this great club. I can’t wait to see you all at the Bridge very soon.
news.body_zh: 在被宣布成为我们新的俱乐部队长后，艾琳·库斯伯特坐下来直接给你们，蓝军的支持者写了一封信……我很荣幸被任命为你们俱乐部的队长。我肩上有责任，我感到兴奋和期待。当我 18 岁搬家时，还是一个年轻、天真的苏格兰小孩子，我从未想象过 10 年后我会成为现在的样子。从我走进科巴姆大门的那一刻起，我就感觉就像在家里一样。当我第一次穿上这件衬衫时，感觉很不错。我的队友、工作人员以及所有让这个俱乐部每天运转的人——你们立刻让我感觉我属于这里。我非常尊重在我之前的队长，我很幸运能够在俱乐部史无前例的10年历史中最精彩的部分向他们学习，我永远感谢他们中的每一位将俱乐部带到了现在的位置。我知道追随在我之前领导过这家具乐部的伟大队长所带来的责任。我永远不会掉以轻心。现在我们拥有资源和基础设施来确保我们能够做到最好。这取决于我们作为球员的表现。我对历史和遗产有强烈的感情；那时为俱乐部未来的成功奠定了基础。这就是切尔西的建立基础，并且随着我们的前进，它也将继续如此。对于俱乐部来说，这是一个激动人心的时刻。有新球员、新员工，当然还有斯坦福桥的新家。背景也发生了很多变化——真正积极的变化将有助于提升女队。我很自豪能够带领团队度过难关。我对未来充满期待，因为我们拥有一支伟大的团队，渴望取得成功，同样，我们也有一支在幕后推动俱乐部发展的伟大团队。每个人都想让这个俱乐部成为最好的俱乐部。很难用语言来形容你们这些支持者对我来说有多重要。你们中的一些人已经成为我生活的一部分十多年了……我见到你们的次数比见到家人的次数还多。您支持我度过了一些困难时期，您是我们取得如此巨大成功的重要原因。庆祝我赢得的 18 个奖杯中的每一个，让我离开家和家人变得值得。我在这里组建了我的第二个家庭。感觉就像我们被束缚在一起。很高兴您能与我们一起踏上旅程，现在我们要搬到斯坦福桥，您应该像我们一样获得回报。我什至还记得多年前我加入斯坦斯时你们跟随我们的一些面孔。您曾前往全国各地和欧洲各地观看比赛，有些甚至是圣诞节前几天的冠军联赛。你给了我们额外的码数，额外的强度。我认为你没有意识到你能带来多大的改变——欧冠联赛主场对阵里昂，曼城逆转。没有你，这些根本就不会发生。在切尔西女足，我们谈论永无止境。对我来说，这意味着当感觉不舒服时不要放弃，战斗到最后并找到获胜的方法。我们想要继续成长。我们想要赢得奖杯。我们想看看这个团队在一起能做什么。感谢您迄今为止对这一旅程的所有支持——让我们继续共同为这个伟大的俱乐部创造历史。我迫不及待地想很快在桥上见到你们。

news.title: Erin Cuthbert named new Chelsea Women captain
news.title_zh: 艾琳·库斯伯特被任命为切尔西女足新任队长
news.body_en: Chelsea Football Club is delighted to announce that Erin Cuthbert has been confirmed as our new women's team captain. The midfielder joined the Blues as a teenager from her native Scotland in December 2016 and made her Chelsea debut in April 2017. She takes on the armband following the retirement of former skipper Millie Bright at the end of April. ‘It’s a great honour,’ said Cuthbert. ‘I never imagined myself doing this 10 years ago or being in the position that I am. It’s beyond the wildest dreams of a little girl from Irvine. ‘I know the weight the armband comes with at a club like Chelsea, and I'm ready to step up and show that I can live up to that.’ Cuthbert has made 301 appearances for Chelsea and scored 70 goals. She has been at the club for all but two of our 20 trophy wins, claiming seven Women’s Super League titles, one Spring Series, five Women’s FA Cups, four Women’s League Cups and a Women’s Community Shield. Chelsea head coach Sonia Bompastor said: ‘What stands out about Erin is her character on and off the pitch, her standards, and the way she leads by example every single day. ‘You need to understand what this club means to captain Chelsea, and I think Erin is the person who knows that best. You need to care deeply and you need to be ready to take responsibility. ‘Erin has all of those qualities. She's passionate about the game, she's brave, she's honest and she always wants to push the team to be better. In the dressing room, she brings energy, personality and belief. ‘She cares about the people around her and I think that's what makes her such a natural leader.’ Cuthbert has also been the Scotland national team vice-captain since February 2026 and was awarded the Chelsea Player of the Season Award in 2019 and again in our domestic Treble-winning season of 2024/25.
news.body_zh: 切尔西足球俱乐部很高兴地宣布艾琳·库斯伯特已被确认为我们的新女队队长。这位中场球员于 2016 年 12 月从祖国苏格兰加入蓝军，并于 2017 年 4 月完成了在切尔西的处子秀。在前队长米莉·布莱特于 4 月底退役后，她接过了队长袖标。 “这是一个巨大的荣誉，”卡斯伯特说。 “十年前我从未想象过自己会做出这样的事，也从未想象过自己会处于现在的位置。这超出了欧文小女孩最疯狂的梦想。 “我知道队长袖标对于切尔西这样的俱乐部来说有多么重要，我已经准备好站出来证明我能够做到这一点。”库斯伯特已经为切尔西出场 301 次，打进 70 个进球。在我们赢得的 20 座奖杯中，除了两座之外，她一直在俱乐部效力，并获得了 7 座女子超级联赛冠军、1 座春季系列赛冠军、5 座女子足总杯冠军、4 座女子联赛杯冠军和 1 座女子社区盾冠军。切尔西主教练索尼娅·邦帕斯托表示：“艾琳的突出之处在于她在球场内外的性格、她的标准以及她每天以身作则的方式。 `你需要了解这家具乐部对切尔西队长意味着什么，我认为艾琳是最了解这一点的人。您需要深切关心，并且需要准备好承担责任。 “艾琳拥有所有这些品质。她对比赛充满热情，她勇敢，她诚实，她总是想推动球队变得更好。在更衣室里，她带来了活力、个性和信念。 “她关心周围的人，我认为这使她成为天生的领导者。”库斯伯特自 2026 年 2 月起一直担任苏格兰国家队副队长，并于 2019 年荣获切尔西赛季最佳球员奖，并在 2024/25 赛季再次获得国内三冠王。

news.title: FPL 2026/27: Chelsea Gameweek three
news.title_zh: FPL 2026/27：切尔西第三周比赛
news.body_en: Chelsea have teamed up with Fantasy Football Scout to help bring you hints, tips and advice during the 2026/27 Fantasy Premier League (FPL) season. Scout will be using their expertise to provide advice and gameweek tips which should prove useful in ensuring you win your mini-leagues. Here, we look at which of the Blues' players are must-haves, who the best value-for-money picks are and why Joao Pedro (£7.7m) is Chelsea’s most popular player. Cole Palmer (£9.6m) is looking back to his best and becoming essential in FPL. Following his double-digit haul in gameweek one, the Englishman followed it up with a goal against Brighton & Hove Albion. Palmer racked up four shots on goal and an expected goal involvement tally of 0.79. His early performances will encourage Fantasy managers that Palmer is capable of producing the kind of form shown in 2023/24, when he returned 244 points in 29 starts, and that he is a viable captaincy option. His ownership continues to grow, with another 650,000+ transfers in this week. Morgan Rogers (£7.5m) continued his superb start to life in a Blues shirt with another attacking return, this time an assist following his goal at Craven Cottage in gameweek one. No Chelsea player has registered more expected goal involvements (xGI) or created more big chances so far this season. While Palmer and Joao Pedro are proving more popular, Rogers continues to fly under the radar as a consistent Fantasy asset with strong minutes. Making his first start of the campaign, Pedro Neto (£6.5m) impressed at right wing-back, scoring the Blues’ second goal. The Portugal international had two shots on target and created a big chance against Brighton. Neto is one to watch as the cheapest Blues attacker in FPL to have started a league game so far. Unsurprisingly, Joao Pedro (£7.7m) is the highest-owned Chelsea FPL player – and indeed in the entire game. The Brazilian currently sits in just under 70 per cent of teams. Following his nine-point haul against Brighton, more than 750,000 managers have brought in the Brazilian ahead of Friday’s gameweek three deadline, resulting in another price rise of £0.1m. Joao Pedro is the top-scoring forward in Fantasy by five points, despite scoring an unfortunate own goal against the Seagulls. Among Blues players, Joao Pedro leads the way for shots (nine), big chances (three), penalty box touches (17) and expected goals (1.85). This continues a trend from last season when Chelsea’s No.9 led the way for all four of those metrics. Although it will be a tough assignment on Sunday, with Arsenal yet to concede a goal, Joao Pedro will undoubtedly be at the heart of the Blues' offensive threat. No team has scored more goals than Chelsea. In defence, Jorrel Hato (£4.5m) has started consecutive matches at left wing-back and showcased his attacking potential with a superb assist for Joao Pedro against Brighton. Owned by fewer than one per cent of Fantasy managers, the Dutchman is the cheapest way into the Chelsea back line and has had more penalty box touches (four) than any of his fellow Blues defenders. In the back three, Levi Colwill (£5m) started once again and was just one defensive contribution away from the required threshold for two additional points at the time of his substitution. If the Englishman can add regular defensive contribution points to his locker, he will quickly become great value for money.
news.body_zh: 切尔西已与 Fantasy Football Scout 合作，帮助您在 2026/27 Fantasy Premier League (FPL) 赛季期间为您提供提示、技巧和建议。球探将利用他们的专业知识提供建议和比赛周技巧，这对确保您赢得迷你联赛很有用。在这里，我们来看看哪些蓝军球员是必备球员，谁是最具性价比的球员，以及为什么若奥·佩德罗（770万英镑）是切尔西最受欢迎的球员。科尔·帕尔默（Cole Palmer，960 万英镑）正在回顾自己的最佳状态，并成为 FPL 中的重要人物。继第一周比赛取得两位数进球后，这位英国人在对阵布莱顿的比赛中又攻入一球。帕尔默共射门 4 次，预期进球数为 0.79。他早期的表现将鼓励幻想队主教练相信帕尔默有能力打出2023/24赛季的表现，当时他在29场首发中拿下244分，并且他是一个可行的队长选择。他的所有权持续增长，本周又进行了超过 650,000 次转会。摩根·罗杰斯（750万英镑）继续着他身披蓝军球衣的精彩开局，再次发起进攻，这一次是他在第一周对阵克雷文小屋的进球后的一次助攻。本赛季迄今为止，没有一位切尔西球员的预期进球参与度（xGI）或创造的绝佳机会比他多。虽然帕尔默和若昂·佩德罗越来越受欢迎，但罗杰斯作为梦幻队的稳定资产，上场时间很长，但仍然没有受到关注。佩德罗·内托（Pedro Neto，650万英镑）在本赛季首次首发，在右翼卫位置上给人留下了深刻的印象，打进了蓝军的第二个进球。这位葡萄牙国脚在对阵布莱顿的比赛中两次射门，创造了绝佳机会。内托是迄今为止 FPL 中首发联赛最便宜的蓝军攻击手之一。不出所料，若奥·佩德罗（770 万英镑）是切尔西 FPL 球员中身价最高的球员——事实上，在整场比赛中也是如此。目前，巴西人在球队中的出场率略低于 70%。继对阵布莱顿的比赛中拿下 9 分后，超过 750,000 名教练在周五第三周比赛截止日期之前引进了这位巴西人，导致价格再次上涨 10 万英镑。尽管在对阵海鸥队的比赛中不幸打进乌龙球，但若昂·佩德罗还是幻想队中得分最高的前锋，领先 5 分。在蓝军球员中，若昂·佩德罗在射门（9次）、绝佳机会（3次）、禁区触球（17次）和预期进球（1.85）方面领先。这延续了上赛季的趋势，当时切尔西的 9 号球员在所有四项指标上都处于领先地位。尽管周日这将是一项艰巨的任务，阿森纳尚未丢球，但若昂·佩德罗无疑将成为蓝军进攻威胁的核心。没有球队比切尔西进球更多。在防守方面，乔雷尔·哈托（Jorrel Hato，450万英镑）连续在左翼卫的比赛中首发，并在对阵布莱顿的比赛中为若奥·佩德罗送出了精彩的助攻，展示了他的进攻潜力。荷兰人的拥有率不到 1% 的幻想队主教练，他是进入切尔西后防线最便宜的方式，并且比其他蓝军后卫有更多的禁区触球次数（4 次）。在后三名球员中，列维·科尔威尔（Levi Colwill，500万英镑）再次首发，在他被换下时，距离获得额外两分所需的门槛仅差一分。如果英国人能够为他的储物柜添加常规的防守贡献点，他将很快变得物有所值。

news.title: Vote now for your Chelsea August Goal of the Month winner!
news.title_zh: 立即投票选出切尔西八月最佳进球得主！
news.body_en: Several memorable Chelsea strikes were scored in August, and we are asking Blues supporters to vote for their favourite in our first Goal of the Month vote of the season. The new campaign has started well for our men's side under Xabi Alonso. Premier League victories have been recorded over Fulham and Brighton and Hove Albion, while Luton Town were defeated in the Carabao Cup second round. Nine goals have been scored along the way – and many have been shortlisted in our August Goal of the Month vote. There is also representation from our Academy sides, with special strikes from those featuring for Cobham Next Gen and our Under-18s. The vote is now open on the Chelsea Official App, and supporters can watch each of the nominated goals below before having their say. McGillvary gets a Goal of the Month nomination with his first for our Under-18s. The schoolboy gave the Blues a lead after six minutes against Birmingham, and we raced away to a 4-1 victory. What a first goal it was from McGillvary, who steadied himself and arrowed a shot into the top corner from outside the box. The Brazilian gave us the perfect start inside the first 33 seconds of our season. There was little danger when a Fulham clearance was sent into the Chelsea half, but Maxence Lacroix won his header and the ball broke to Palmer, who deftly flicked it into Joao Pedro's path. He took a touch before finishing coolly over Bernd Leno. This was a well-worked team move which showcased the fluidity of our football under Alonso. Centre-back Lacroix was found in the Fulham penalty area by Palmer, and he tricked his way past Jorge Cuenca and crossed from the byline. Rogers arrived perfectly and swept home to net on his Chelsea debut. Our 3-2 victory at Craven Cottage was secured in the second half by Palmer. Rogers flicked a header on to Joao Pedro, who bound into the Fulham half, waited for an overlap from the England international and slipped in his fellow attacker. Cole assessed his options and opted to guide a shot between the goalkeeper's legs. A dramatic comeback by Cobham Next Gen against senior opposition secured a 2-2 draw, and was followed by a penalty shootout victory. The Blues were kicked into life in the game by Bettoni, who provided a neat first-time finish after Sol Gordon drove to the byline and cut the ball back for his team-mate. This was the first of three goals Pennie scored to get his hat-trick at Cobham against the Royals. The striker showed his strength to hold a defender at arm’s length before smashing a shot into the top corner. Heze Grimwade gets plenty of credit too for threading a defence-splitting pass into Pennie's path. Neto pounced to put us two goals ahead inside the first 15 minutes of our first home Premier League fixture of the season. Rogers was the creator, collecting a Joao Pedro knock-down and forcing his way past Mario Vuskovic. The England international squared the ball and Neto burst forward to finish beyond Bart Verbruggen. Joao Pedro, given a less-than-friendly reception by the fans of his former club Brighton, briefly silenced the away end with a deserved goal. Jorrel Hato was instrumental, exchanging passes in our half with Rogers and surging upfield. The Dutchman eventually fed the ball to Joao Pedro and the Blues' No.9 made no mistake with his finish. Our third nomination from the Brighton win and second for Cole, just like his first, was the match winner. It was also yet another example of our front three combining incisively, as Joao Pedro controlled and laid off a throw-in for Palmer to collect. The latter advanced 20 yards and then curled a shot expertly beyond Verbruggen. Richards played his part in a stunning fightback by the Blues, who came from three goals down on the brink of half-time to triumph 5-4 in a thrilling match. Richards netted our second goal as we built momentum. Reggie Watson and Bettoni had already had efforts blocked, but there was no stopping Richards' follow-up, as he smashed his shot into the back of the net.
news.body_zh: 八月份，切尔西队打进了几个令人难忘的进球，我们邀请蓝军球迷在本赛季的第一次本月最佳进球投票中投票选出他们最喜欢的进球。在哈维·阿隆索的带领下，我们男队的新赛季开局良好。英超联赛战胜了富勒姆、布莱顿和霍夫阿尔比恩，而卢顿镇则在卡拉宝杯第二轮中被击败。一路走来，我们已经打进了九个进球，其中许多进球已入围我们的八月份本月进球投票。我们的青训营也有代表，其中包括科巴姆下一代和我们 18 岁以下青年队的代表。投票现已在切尔西官方应用程序上开放，支持者可以在发表意见之前观看以下每个提名的进球。麦吉尔瓦里凭借他为我们 18 岁以下青年队效力的第一个进球而获得本月最佳进球提名。在对阵伯明翰的比赛中，这位男学生在六分钟后帮助蓝军取得领先，最终我们以 4-1 的比分取得了胜利。这是麦吉尔瓦里的第一个进球，他稳住了自己，从禁区外将球射入球门上角。巴西人在赛季的前 33 秒内为我们带来了完美的开局。当富勒姆解围进入切尔西半场时，几乎没有什么危险，但马克森斯·拉克鲁瓦赢得了头球，皮球传给了帕尔默，帕尔默巧妙地将球弹到若昂·佩德罗的路径上。他触球后冷静地战胜了贝恩德·莱诺。这是一次出色的团队合作，展示了阿隆索带领下我们足球的流畅性。中后卫拉克鲁瓦在富勒姆禁区内被帕尔默发现，他巧妙地越过豪尔赫·昆卡并从边线传中。罗杰斯完美抵达并在切尔西首秀中横扫进球。下半场帕尔默帮助我们以 3-2 战胜了克雷文小屋。罗杰斯将头球传给若昂·佩德罗，佩德罗跳入富勒姆半场，等待英格兰国脚的补射，然后滑入他的队友攻击手。科尔评估了自己的选择，选择从守门员两腿之间射门。 Cobham Next Gen 戏剧性地逆转对手，最终以 2-2 战平，并通过点球大战取得胜利。贝托尼在比赛中为蓝军注入了活力，在索尔·戈登突破到边线并将球回传给队友后，贝托尼首次完成了漂亮的射门。这是佩尼在科巴姆对阵皇家队的比赛中上演帽子戏法的三个进球中的第一个。这位前锋展示了他的力量，将防守队员拉开一臂距离，然后将射门打入球门上角。赫泽·格里姆韦德（Heze Grimwade）也因将一脚突破防线的传球穿入彭尼的路线而获得了很多赞誉。在我们本赛季第一场英超主场比赛的前 15 分钟内，内托突然出击，让我们领先两球。罗杰斯是创造者，他接住了若昂·佩德罗的击倒，并强行超越了马里奥·武斯科维奇。这位英格兰国脚将球摆正，内托向前突破，超越了巴特·维尔布鲁根。若昂·佩德罗受到前俱乐部布莱顿球迷不太友好的接待，他以一个当之无愧的进球短暂地压制了客队的表现。乔雷尔·哈托（Jorrel Hato）发挥了重要作用，他在我们半场与罗杰斯交换传球，并在前场冲锋陷阵。荷兰人最终将球传给若奥·佩德罗，蓝军9号的射门没有失误。我们在布莱顿获胜后的第三次提名和科尔的第二次提名，就像他的第一次一样，是比赛的获胜者。这也是我们前场三人精妙配合的又一个例子，若奥·佩德罗控制并掷出界外球，让帕尔默接球。后者推进了 20 码，然后熟练地一记弧线球越过了维尔布鲁根。理查兹在蓝军的惊人反击中发挥了重要作用，蓝军在半场结束前落后三球的情况下最终以 5-4 获胜，赢得了一场激动人心的比赛。随着我们的势头增强，理查兹打进了我们的第二个进球。雷吉·沃森和贝托尼的射门已经被挡出，但理查兹的跟进却无法阻止，他的射门入网。

news.body_en: Chelsea Women play at Stamford Bridge for the first time since making it our permanent home on Saturday lunch time as we kick off our Women's Super League campaign for the 2026/27 season against Aston Villa. Having secured our qualification for this season's UEFA Women's Champions League with a 6-2 aggregate win over Real Sociedad, thoughts quickly turn to our domestic curtain-raiser at Stamford Bridge. The Blues will play all of our WSL fixtures at our new permanent home from this season onwards, beginning with Saturday's lunch-time game against Villa. Here is everything you need to know about how to watch Chelsea Women against Aston Villa, including kick-off time and how to follow the action on official Chelsea channels. Chelsea Women's game against Aston Villa takes place on Saturday 5 September 2026 at Stamford Bridge, with kick-off scheduled for 12.35pm UK time. Tickets are still available to purchase for Saturday's match, but if you can't make it to Stamford Bridge, then you can watch the match live on BBC One, BBC iPlayer and the BBC Sport website in the UK. As always, team news, live updates and match coverage will be provided in our Chelsea Women vs Aston Villa Women Match Centre on the Chelsea Official App and Chelsea website. You can also follow along via Chelsea Women’s social media channels on X, Facebook, Instagram and TikTok. The Blues go into the match having won back-to-back games against Real Sociedad in our Women's Champions League qualifying third round tie, by an aggregate score of 6-2. Meanwhile, Aston Villa come into the new season after a difficult start to 2026. Only relegated Leicester City (zero) won fewer points in the WSL during 2026 than Aston Villa did with their tally of seven. The Villans’ average of 0.6 points per game this year is their worst on record in the Women’s Super League in a calendar year. Chelsea have won all 12 of our Women’s Super League meetings with Aston Villa. Despite losing 4-3, Aston Villa scored more goals in their most recent WSL game against Chelsea, in March, than in their prior 11 league meetings with the Blues (two goals). That was also the first game in Women’s Super League history in which both teams scored three first-half goals. In the away meeting last season, Chelsea won 3-1 with goals from Aggie Beever-Jones, Keira Walsh and Sam Kerr. Be there to welcome CFCW to our new home at Stamford Bridge when we take on Aston Villa in our first Women's Super League match of the season on 5 September at 12.35pm!

news.body_en: The draw for the league phase of this season's UEFA Women's Champions League takes place on Friday, with the Blues set to learn our next opponents in European competition. Sonia Bompastor's side completed the job in the third qualifying round of the Women's Champions League with a 1-0 win away at Real Sociedad on Wednesday evening, thanks to Keira Walsh's second-half goal. That gave us a 6-2 victory over the Spaniards on aggregate and put our name in the hat for the next stage of the competition. Here is everything you need to know ahead of the draw for the league phase of the UEFA Women's Champions League. The draw takes place at 11am UK time (12pm CET) on Friday 4 September. The draw will be streamed live on UEFA.com and the official UEFA Women's Champions League app and will last around 45 minutes. The draw takes place at the House of European Football in Nyon, Switzerland. Nine teams qualified automatically for the league phase and are joined by nine clubs, including Chelsea, who entered via the third qualifying round play-off ties. Under the format introduced last season, teams face fixtures against six different sides in the league phase, playing half of those matches at home and half of them away. The 18 participating teams will be split into three pots based on their individual club coefficient ranking, with Chelsea among the top seeds in Pot 1. Each team will then be drawn to play two opponents from each of the three pots, playing one match against a team from each pot at home and one away. In principle, teams from the same association cannot be drawn against each other, and each team may play against a maximum of two opponents from any other one association, although UEFA reserves the right to adapt this rule in case of deadlock situations or any other relevant constraints. There are 18 teams competing at this stage of the competition. The Blues will face two sides from each of the three pots below, but clubs from the same association are kept apart at this stage. It means we cannot be paired with another English club in the league phase. news.title: Denner signs for Chelsea
news.title_zh: 登纳加盟切尔西
news.body_en: Chelsea is pleased to confirm the signing of Denner from Brazilian side Corinthians, with the full-back signing a contract until 2034. Denner, whose full name is Denner Alves Evangelista Pereira, has joined up with the Chelsea CNG squad. The 18-year-old is a forward-thinking, left-sided defender who rose through the youth ranks at his hometown club and last year starred as Corinthians Under-20s finished runners-up in the prestigious Copa São Paulo de Futebol Júnior cup. He scored three goals and provided two assists throughout the competition, including the opener in the final with Sao Paulo. Denner is a Brazil youth international and was a member of their Under-17 side that won the South American Championships in 2025.
news.body_zh: 切尔西很高兴确认从巴西科林蒂安队签下丹纳，这名后卫的合同到2034年为止。丹纳的全名是丹纳·阿尔维斯·埃万杰利斯塔·佩雷拉，他已经加入了切尔西 CNG 球队。这位 18 岁的球员是一名具有前瞻性思维的左翼后卫，他在家乡俱乐部的青年队中崭露头角，去年代表科林蒂安 20 岁以下青年队在著名的圣保罗杯青年足球赛中获得亚军。他在整场比赛中攻入3球并贡献2次助攻，其中包括在与圣保罗队的决赛中的首开纪录。丹纳是一名巴西青年国脚，也是 2025 年赢得南美锦标赛冠军的 17 岁以下球队的成员。

news.title: Vote for Cole Palmer to win Premier League Goal of the Month!
news.title_zh: 投票支持科尔·帕尔默赢得英超本月最佳进球！
news.body_en: Cole Palmer’s winner against Brighton & Hove Albion has been nominated for the August Guinness Premier League Goal of the Month award. Palmer has made a fantastic start to the 2026/27 season as part of Xabi Alonso’s exciting front three and, alongside Joao Pedro, has already been shortlisted for Premier League Player of the Month honour. Blues boss Xabi Alonso is in the running for Manager of the Month. Our No.10 has registered two goals – both winners – and an assist in our opening two Premier League fixtures of the campaign, and the second of those, scored against Brighton, has earned him a nomination for Premier League Goal of the Month. Vote for Cole Palmer to win Premier League Goal of the Month It was a fine strike, as Palmer collected the ball from Joao Pedro, carried it 20 yards into a dangerous position, and expertly curled a shot beyond Bart Verbruggen and into the back of the net. Voting for the August Premier League Goal of the Month award is open now, and you can cast your vote for Cole to receive the award here until the poll closes at midday on Monday 7 September. The winner will be announced at 1pm on Friday 11 September. Palmer’s rivals for the award on the eight-goal shortlist are: Emersonn (Ipswich Town), Nilson Angulo (Sunderland), Keane Lewis-Potter, Kevin Schade (both Brentford), Joe Willock, Anthony Elanga (both Newcastle United) and Rayan Cherki (Manchester City).

news.title: Joao Pedro analysis: Why the Blues' master of all trades stands alone in 2026
news.title_zh: 若昂·佩德罗分析：为什么蓝军的万能大师在 2026 年独树一帜
news.body_en: Since the start of 2026, no Premier League player has scored more goals in all competitions than Joao Pedro. As he begins his second full season in Blue, the Brazilian has made himself at home at the centre of Chelsea’s attack. And what a start he has made to the new campaign. The 24-year-old registered a goal and an assist in our opening weekend win over Fulham at Craven Cottage, and repeated the feat in our first outing at Stamford Bridge: a 4-3 victory over Brighton and Hove Albion. That takes Joao Pedro’s Premier League goals tally for Chelsea to 17, just two shy of what he managed in two seasons at Brighton. But look at his contribution across all competitions and the figures are even more impressive. Since the beginning of 2026, no Premier League player can better Joao Pedro’s 15 goals in all competitions – and his strikes against Fulham and Brighton suggest he shows no signs of slowing down any time soon. His performance against Brighton in our first home league game of 2026/27 was arguably one of his best yet for the Blues, as he topped stats tables across the board and was voted by supporters on the Chelsea Official App as our Player of the Match. A versatile forward when he arrived at Stamford Bridge, Joao Pedro has increasingly been used as the central striker in the Blues’ attack, currently spearheading an exciting front three alongside Cole Palmer and Morgan Rogers in the early stages of Xabi Alonso’s reign. That has seen Joao Pedro’s goalscoring instincts come to the fore as a penalty box predator, with all but one of his 15 goals in 2026 coming from inside the area – his stunning UEFA Champions League strike away at Napoli back in January the one exception. There has been a ruthless efficiency to his game too: his 25 goals for the Blues better his expected goals total of 22.4, and he is averaging a goal every 162 minutes, better than one goal every two games. When looking at the chances he has had compared to the goals he has scored, it gets even better, with a shot conversion rate of 22 per cent. Of his 115 attempted shots, 52 per cent have found the target, and of those 55 per cent have ended up in the back of the net. It is not just his finishing that has been so impressive; his all-round game has been leading the way for Chelsea since he arrived at Stamford Bridge. With assists factored in, Joao Pedro has 33 goal contributions in his 54 appearances for the Blues. The next best of our current squad are Pedro Neto and Palmer, with 21 goal contributions each during the same period. Neto is also the only Chelsea player who can better Joao Pedro’s 66 completed dribbles, while there is athleticism and physicality to go with the silky skills and precise finishing. The Brazilian also tops our charts for duels won – 296 – 33 more than second-placed Moises Caicedo – and no current Chelsea player can match his 102 aerial duels won since the start of last season. A true master of all trades then, but it's Joao Pedro’s prolific form in front of goal that continues to catch the eye in 2026.
news.body_zh: 自2026年初以来，没有哪位英超球员在所有比赛中进球数超过若昂·佩德罗。当他开始在蓝军的第二个完整赛季时，巴西人已经成为切尔西进攻的中心。他为新的竞选活动开了一个好头。这位 24 岁的球员在我们首周末在克雷文小屋战胜富勒姆的比赛中打入一球并助攻一次，并在我们在斯坦福桥的首场比赛中重复了这一壮举：4-3 战胜布莱顿和霍夫阿尔比恩。这使得若奥·佩德罗在切尔西的英超进球数达到了 17 个，仅比他在布莱顿两个赛季的进球数少了两个。但看看他在所有比赛中的贡献，这些数字更加令人印象深刻。自 2026 年初以来，没有任何一位英超球员能够超越若昂·佩德罗在各项赛事中打进的 15 个进球，而他在对阵富勒姆和布莱顿的比赛中的进球表明他在短期内没有表现出放慢脚步的迹象。他在 2026/27 年首场主场联赛对阵布莱顿的比赛中的表现可以说是他在蓝军迄今为止的最佳表现之一，因为他在各项数据统计表上名列前茅，并在切尔西官方应用程序上被支持者票选为我们的本场最佳球员。若昂·佩德罗来到斯坦福桥时是一名多才多艺的前锋，他越来越多地被用作蓝军进攻中的中锋，目前在哈维·阿隆索统治的早期阶段，他与科尔·帕尔默和摩根·罗杰斯一起成为令人兴奋的前三名前锋。这让若昂·佩德罗作为禁区掠夺者的进球本能凸显出来，他在 2026 年的 15 个进球中，除了 1 个进球外，全部来自禁区内——他在一月份客场对阵那不勒斯的欧冠联赛中令人惊叹的进球是一个例外。他的比赛效率也很高：他为蓝军打进的 25 个进球超过了他的预期进球总数 22.4 个，而且他平均每 162 分钟就有一个进球，比每两场比赛一个进球要好。如果将他获得的机会与进球数进行比较，结果会更好，射门转化率为 22%。在他的 115 次射门中，52% 命中目标，其中 55% 最终入网。令人印象深刻的不仅仅是他的射门，还有他的表现。自从他来到斯坦福桥以来，他的全面比赛一直引领着切尔西队的发展。如果算上助攻，若昂·佩德罗在为蓝军出场的 54 场比赛中贡献了 33 个进球。我们目前阵容中排名第二的是佩德罗·内托和帕尔默，他们在同一时期各自贡献了 21 个进球。内托也是唯一一位能够超越若昂·佩德罗的 66 次带球过人的切尔西球员，同时他还拥有运动能力和身体素质，以及流畅的技巧和精确的射门。巴西人还在我们的争顶获胜次数排行榜上名列前茅——296次——比第二名莫伊塞斯·凯塞多多了33次——并且没有任何现任切尔西球员能够与他自上赛季开始以来赢得的102次争顶争顶相媲美。若昂·佩德罗是一位真正的多才多艺的大师，但他在 2026 年继续引人注目的还是门前多产的表现。

news.title: Help Xabi Alonso win Premier League Manager of the Month!
news.title_zh: 帮助哈维·阿隆索赢得本月英超最佳教练！
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso has been included on the shortlist for the August Barclays Premier League Manager of the Month award. A Premier League legend as a player, Alonso made his managerial debut in the competition less than two weeks ago. However, the Spaniard has been nominated for the monthly award at the first attempt. Alonso has made an impressive and exciting start to his tenure as Chelsea manager, with our two matches played in August ending in victory and with seven goals scored. Vote for Xabi Alonso to win Premier League Manager of the Month We began our campaign with a 3-2 victory away at neighbours Fulham before making it two wins from two by beating Brighton & Hove Albion 4-3 at Stamford Bridge. Those games came either side of booking our place in the Carabao Cup third round with a home win over Luton Town. Voting for the August Premier League Manager of the Month award is open now, and you can vote for Alonso to receive the award here until the poll closes at midday on Monday 7 September. The winner will be announced at midday on Friday 11 September. The shortlist for this season’s first Premier League Manager of the Month award also includes Mikel Arteta (Arsenal), Sergej Jakirovic (Hull City) and Enzo Maresca (Manchester City).
news.body_zh: 哈维·阿隆索已被列入八月份巴克莱英超月度最佳教练奖的候选名单。作为球员时期的英超传奇人物，阿隆索在不到两周前在英超联赛中首次亮相。然而，西班牙人却一次就获得了月度奖的提名。阿隆索在担任切尔西主教练期间取得了令人印象深刻且令人兴奋的开局，我们在八月份进行的两场比赛均以胜利告终，并打进了七个进球。投票支持哈比·阿隆索赢得本月英超最佳教练 我们以客场 3-2 战胜邻国富勒姆的方式开始了新赛季的比赛，随后又在斯​​坦福桥以 4-3 击败布莱顿，取得了两胜两胜的成绩。这些比赛都是我们主场战胜卢顿镇而获得卡拉宝杯第三轮席位的两场比赛。 8月英超最佳教练奖投票现已开放，您可以在这里投票支持阿隆索获得该奖项，直到 9 月 7 日星期一中午投票结束。获胜者将于 9 月 11 日星期五中午公布。本赛季首届英超月度最佳教练的入围名单还包括米克尔·阿尔特塔（阿森纳）、谢尔盖·雅基罗维奇（赫尔城）和恩佐·马雷斯卡（曼城）。

International Coverage: The match will be available via local Premier League TV rights holders in other countries. news.title: Two Blues shortlisted for Premier League Player of the Month award
news.title_zh: 两名蓝军入围英超月度最佳球员奖
news.body_en: Cole Palmer and Joao Pedro have both been nominated for the August EA Sports Premier League Player of the Month award. The two forwards have started the 2026/27 season in great form, alongside summer signing Morgan Rogers, in Xabi Alonso’s three-pronged attack. In our opening two Premier League fixtures – against Fulham and Brighton and Hove Albion – Joao Pedro and Palmer registered seven goal involvements between them. Vote for Joao Pedro and Cole Palmer to win Premier League Player of the Month! Joao Pedro made a flying start to the campaign at Fulham, scoring after just 33 seconds following a neat flick from Palmer. The Brazil international then returned the favour, setting up Palmer to score our winner at Craven Cottage from a tight angle. The pair were at it again last weekend, as we hosted Brighton in our first Premier League home fixture.  Joao Pedro netted our third in the 4-3 victory with a tidy finish before teeing up Cole for his stunning dribble and strike to seal the win. Voting for the August Premier League Player of the Month award is open now, and you can cast yours for the two nominated Blues here until midday on Monday 7 September. The winner will be announced at 11am on Friday 11 September. The other players on the eight-man shortlist are: Riccardo Calafiori (Arsenal), Rayan Cherki (Manchester City), Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United), Mamadou Sangare (Brentford), Konstantinos Tzolakis (Hull City) and Yoane Wissa (Newcastle United).
news.body_zh: 科尔·帕尔默 (Cole Palmer) 和若昂·佩德罗 (Joao Pedro) 均获得 EA 体育英超联赛 8 月最佳球员奖提名。这两名前锋在哈维·阿隆索的三管齐下的进攻中，与夏季签约的摩根·罗杰斯一起以出色的状态开始了2026/27赛季。在我们开场的两场英超比赛中——对阵富勒姆、布莱顿和霍夫阿尔比恩——若昂·佩德罗和帕尔默共打进了七个进球。投票给若昂·佩德罗和科尔·帕尔默赢得本月英超最佳球员！若昂·佩德罗在对阵富勒姆的比赛中取得了开门红，仅仅 33 秒后，帕尔默的一脚漂亮的射门就进球了。这位巴西国脚随后也做出了回应，帮助帕尔默在克雷文小屋的小角度攻入制胜球。上周末，我们在首场英超主场比赛中主场迎战布莱顿，两人再次相遇。  若昂·佩德罗以漂亮的射门打进了我们的第三个球，以 4-3 的比分获胜，随后科尔以惊人的运球和射门锁定胜局。八月份英超联赛月度最佳球员奖的投票现已开放，您可以在 9 月 7 日星期一中午之前为两名提名的蓝军投票。获胜者将于 9 月 11 日星期五上午 11 点公布。八人候选名单上的其他球员包括：里卡多·卡拉菲奥里（阿森纳）、拉扬·切尔基（曼城）、布鲁诺·费尔南德斯（曼联）、马马杜·桑加雷（布伦特福德）、康斯坦丁诺斯·佐拉基斯（赫尔城）和约阿内·维萨（纽卡斯尔联）。

news.title: Chelsea Star of the Match against Real Sociedad revealed!
news.title_zh: 切尔西对阵皇家社会的比赛之星揭晓！
news.body_en: The votes have been counted and we can now reveal the player named Chelsea Star of the Match after our 1-0 UEFA Champions League qualifying victory over Real Sociedad on Wednesday. The Blues built on our 5-2 first-leg advantage by winning 1-0 at Estadio Zubieta in San Sebastian last night, with Keira Walsh finding the net for Sonia Bompastor's side. That secured our qualification for this season's Women's Champions League proper, with the league phase draw taking place tomorrow (Friday) morning. And supporters on the Chelsea Official App selected goalscorer Walsh as the star performer on the night, with the midfielder picking up 54 per cent of the votes. Ellie Carpenter, who put in a solid display down the right-hand side, came in second place with a 31 per cent share of the voting. Be there to welcome CFCW to our new home at Stamford Bridge when we take on Aston Villa in our first Women's Super League match of the season on 5 September at 12.35pm!
news.body_zh: 计票已经完成，周三我们在欧冠资格赛中 1-0 战胜皇家社会后，我们现在可以揭晓切尔西本场比赛之星的球员了。昨晚，蓝军在圣塞巴斯蒂安的苏比埃塔体育场以 5-2 的优势取得胜利，凯拉·沃尔什 (Keira Walsh) 为索尼娅·邦帕斯托 (Sonia Bompastor) 的球队攻入一球。这确保了我们获得本赛季女子冠军联赛的参赛资格，联赛阶段抽签将在明天（周五）早上进行。切尔西官方应用程序上的支持者将进球者沃尔什选为当晚表现最佳的中场球员，这位中场球员获得了 54% 的选票。埃莉·卡彭特（Ellie Carpenter）在右侧表现出色，以 31% 的得票率位居第二。 9 月 5 日中午 12 点 35 分，我们将在本赛季首场女子超级联赛对阵阿斯顿维拉的比赛中欢迎 CFCW 来到我们位于斯坦福桥的新家！
