news.title_zh: 索尼娅·邦帕斯特在获得欧冠资格后称赞蓝军年轻球员
news.body_en: Sonia Bompastor praised Real Sociedad’s resolve after our 1-0 win in San Sebastian on Wednesday night and was happy to have the opportunity to feature some of our younger players. Added to our 5-2 win over the Spanish side at Plough Lane last week, we qualified for the Women’s Champions League with a 6-2 aggregate victory. Chelsea Academy graduate Lexi Potter started the match, while fellow Academy star Chloe Sarwie was introduced in place of Sandy Baltimore. New 18-year-old signing Nelly Las also came off the bench. With only two games played, we have already achieved a key objective in our season, and Bompastor was keen to praise the efforts of her team. ‘I'm pleased with the result,’ she said afterwards. ‘We kept a clean sheet, which is always important, and when you do that, you always have a bigger chance to win games. I'm glad we could rotate the team with the starting XI, but also the players who came in. ‘I think today we gave some really good opportunities to the young players to come and experience a Champions League game, so when you have the opportunity to do that, I think it's always something really positive. ‘I'm happy and really excited now to be in the Champions League this season. The goal was for us to qualify, which is what we have done. ‘People will probably think when you are Chelsea, it’s easy to do, but we played against a really strong team in Real Sociedad. Over the two legs, they showed some really good quality, and I think these two games are a really good preparation for us to come into the season in the league.’ The Blues will now return to Cobham, recover and prepare for our first WSL match of the season against Aston Villa on Saturday. Bompastor is hoping for a bumper crowd to cheer her side on as we mark the first game at Stamford Bridge since we made it our permanent home. ‘First, it's time to focus on recovering from the game,’ she continued. ‘We are really excited to come into the WSL game on Saturday against Aston Villa. Playing at Stamford Bridge will also be something really special. ‘We are really excited to start the league on Saturday at home, in front of all our fans. I can't wait to be in that moment. ‘I'm hoping for the fans to show up and to come and support us. We will need their support. It will be an important game because we want to begin strongly and start with a win against Aston Villa.’ This Saturday, Chelsea will play at Stamford Bridge for the first time since it became our permanent home. Welcome the Blues by securing your ticket for our first WSL clash of the season against Aston Villa now!
news.body_zh: 周三晚上我们在圣塞巴斯蒂安以 1-0 战胜皇家社会后，索尼娅·邦帕斯托赞扬了皇家社会的决心，并很高兴有机会让我们的一些年轻球员上场。继上周我们在普劳巷以 5-2 战胜西班牙球队之后，我们又以总比分 6-2 的比分获得了女足欧冠资格。切尔西学院毕业生莱克西·波特首发出场，而学院球星克洛伊·萨维则代替桑迪·巴尔的摩上场。新加盟的 18 岁小将内莉·拉斯 (Nelly Las) 也替补登场。仅进行了两场比赛，我们就已经实现了本赛季的一个关键目标，邦帕斯托热衷于赞扬她的团队的努力。 “我对结果很满意，”她后来说。 “我们保持了不失球，这始终很重要，当你做到这一点时，你总是有更大的机会赢得比赛。我很高兴我们能够轮换首发阵容以及上场的球员。 “我认为今天我们给了年轻球员一些非常好的机会来体验欧冠比赛，所以当你有机会这样做时，我认为这总是非常积极的事情。” “我现在很高兴也很兴奋能够参加本赛季的冠军联赛。我们的目标是晋级，这就是我们所做的。 “人们可能会认为，当你是切尔西的时候，这很容易做到，但我们对阵的是皇家社会一支非常强大的球队。在两回合比赛中，他们表现出了非常好的实力，我认为这两场比赛为我们进入联赛做好了很好的准备。” 蓝军现在将返回科巴姆，恢复并为周六对阵阿斯顿维拉的本赛季第一场 WSL 比赛做准备。邦帕斯特希望在我们纪念斯坦福桥成为我们永久主场以来的第一场比赛时，能够有大量的观众为她的球队加油。 “首先，是时候集中精力从比赛中恢复了，”她继续道。 “我们非常高兴能够参加周六对阵阿斯顿维拉的 WSL 比赛。在斯坦福桥踢球也将是非常特别的事情。 “我们非常高兴能够在周六主场、在所有球迷面前开始联赛。我迫不及待地想在那一刻。 “我希望球迷们能够出现并支持我们。我们需要他们的支持。这将是一场重要的比赛，因为我们希望开局强劲，并以战胜阿斯顿维拉开始。本周六，切尔西将首次在斯坦福桥比赛，这是我们永久主场以来的第一次。欢迎蓝军，立即购买我们本赛季首场 WSL 对阵阿斯顿维拉的比赛门票！

news.title: Match Report: Real Sociedad 0-1 Chelsea (2-6 on agg.)
news.title_zh: 比赛战报：皇家社会 0-1 切尔西（总比分 2-6）
news.body_en: Chelsea will be in Friday's draw for the league phase of the UEFA Women's Champions League after securing a 1-0 win over Real Sociedad at the Estadio Zubieta on Wednesday evening, putting them through with a 6-2 aggregate score. On a hot day in San Sebastian, the Blues kicked off looking to build upon our 5-2 win from Plough Lane the week before. The first half saw the two sides battle against each other with Chelsea in firm control of possession. The second period began with intensity. An Aggie Beever-Jones shot was palmed away by goalkeeper Julia Arrula, and from the resulting corner, the ball fell to Keira Walsh well outside the box, and the England international took the opportunity to hit the shot to put Chelsea 1-0 up and four goals ahead overall. The contest was a tight one, and our Spanish opponents once again proved that they are a force to be reckoned with. Yet the work had been largely done in the final 20 minutes of the first game, setting us up to take a three-goal advantage into this fixture. Sonia Bompastor made four alterations to her starting lineup following our 5-2 victory over the Spanish side at Plough Lane last week, bringing Lucy Bronze, Kadeisha Buchanan, Wieke Kaptein and Lexi Potter onto the XI for the return leg. The match began as it had on home turf: with Real Sociedad keeping the Blues at bay with their well-organised setup. It took 18 minutes for the first real chance of the game when Lauren James released Ellie Carpenter down the right with an insightful pass, but the Australian had her cross intercepted before it could reach Beever-Jones in the middle of the penalty area. James and Carpenter combined again a few minutes later to pick out Walsh, and the midfielder was able to get the shot away, but the ball rolled comfortably into the goalkeeper's arms. There was then some brief danger up at the other end of the pitch when Sociedad's Ava Seelenfreund burst through into the box, but a smart recovery tackle from Naomi Girma stopped the striker in her tracks. Yet the advantage was firmly with Chelsea as we put pressure on the home side, Carpenter getting round the full-back again after almost half an hour and forcing the goalkeeper to get down quickly to make the save. Half-time saw midfielder Giulia Dragoni make her competitive debut for the Blues as she came on in exchange for James after the break. There was a sharper attacking intent from Chelsea, and we soon made the breakthrough when Beever-Jones forced a good save, and Walsh hit one of her trademark shots from range beyond the goalkeeper from the resulting corner. The four-goal overall deficit spurred the home side on to throw caution to the wind. Ainhoa Marin, who scored in the first leg, went close before Kadeisha Buchanan was called upon to make a key tackle inside the box to prevent another chance. Naomi Girma then headed clear a further chance from the home side's fourth corner inside the space of two minutes. Sociedad's competitiveness really made things tough for Chelsea, and although we were restricted in terms of clear-cut chances, there were plenty of positives to take from the evening. Substitutes Alyssa Thompson and Maika Hamano caused plenty of problems with their movement up front, while Nelly Las gave a good account of herself as she also made her competitive debut for the Blues. This was by no means a classic Chelsea performance, but the most important factor was to get the job done and we did so with professionalism and control. After the first leg, Sociedad could've gone all out in attack to reduce the deficit, but they stayed true to themselves as they worked hard to keep us from extending the lead even further. We now head into Saturday's WSL clash with Aston Villa at Stamford Bridge knowing that we have already secured an important objective with only two games played. We will now compete in this season's Women's Champions League, beginning with the league phase. Chelsea are through to the league phase, and we will discover our opponents on Friday when the draw is made in Nyon. We take on Aston Villa in the Women's Super League at Stamford Bridge on Saturday at 12.35pm and you can still secure your tickets by clicking here! news.body_zh: 周三晚上，切尔西在苏别塔球场以 1-0 战胜皇家社会，总比分 6-2 晋级，随后切尔西将进入周五的女足欧洲冠军联赛联赛阶段抽签。在圣塞巴斯蒂安炎热的一天，蓝军开局希望在前一周以 5-2 战胜 Plough Lane 的基础上再接再厉。上半场双方展开对攻，切尔西牢牢掌控控球权。第二节比赛开始时强度很大。阿吉·比弗-琼斯的射门被门将朱莉娅·阿鲁拉挡出，球从开出的角球落到禁区外的凯拉·沃尔什手中，这位英格兰国脚抓住机会射门，切尔西1-0领先，总比分领先4球。这场比赛非常激烈，我们的西班牙对手再次证明了他们是一支不可忽视的力量。然而，这些工作大部分是在第一场比赛的最后 20 分钟完成的，这让我们在这场比赛中取得了三球的优势。上周我们在普洛巷以 5-2 战胜西班牙球队后，索尼娅·邦帕斯托对首发阵容进行了四次调整，将露西·布朗兹、卡德莎·布坎南、维克·卡普坦和莱克西·波特纳入次回合的首发阵容。比赛一开始就像在主场一样：皇家社会队以他们精心组织的布阵将蓝军拒之门外。比赛进行到第 18 分钟时，劳伦·詹姆斯 (Lauren James) 在右路巧妙传球，释放了埃莉·卡彭特 (Ellie Carpenter)，但澳大利亚人的传中在传到禁区中路的比弗·琼斯 (Beever-Jones) 之前被拦截。几分钟后，詹姆斯和卡彭特再次联手将沃尔什挡出，沃尔什成功射门，但球却轻松地滚进了门将的怀里。随后，球场另一端出现了一些短暂的危险，皇家社会队的艾娃·西伦弗罗因德冲入禁区，但内奥米·吉尔玛的巧妙铲球阻止了这位前锋的脚步。然而切尔西占据了绝对的优势，我们向主队施压，卡彭特在近半小时后再次绕过边后卫，迫使守门员迅速下场扑救。半场结束时，中场球员朱莉娅·德拉戈尼在中场休息后替换詹姆斯上场，完成了蓝军的正式比赛首秀。切尔西的进攻意图更为敏锐，我们很快就取得了突破，比弗-琼斯强行做出了一次漂亮的扑救，沃尔什在角球处从守门员之外射出了她标志性的一记射门。四球的总比分落后促使主队将谨慎抛在了脑后。在首回合比赛中进球的阿伊霍亚·马林(Ainhoa Marin)差点进球，随后卡德伊莎·布坎南(Kadeisha Buchanan)在禁区内进行了一次关键铲球，阻止了另一次机会。随后，内奥米·吉尔玛在两分钟内从主队第四个角球处头球破门。皇家社会的竞争力确实让切尔西的处境变得艰难，尽管我们在明确的机会方面受到限制，但晚上还是有很多积极的一面。替补球员艾莉莎·汤普森和麦卡·滨野在前场的跑动造成了很多问题，而内莉·拉斯也很好地展示了自己，她也为蓝军完成了自己的正式比赛首秀。这绝不是切尔西的经典表现，但最重要的因素是完成工作，我们以专业精神和控制力做到了这一点。首回合比赛结束后，皇家社会本可以全力进攻来缩小差距，但他们仍然忠于自己，努力阻止我们进一步扩大领先优势。现在我们将进入周六在斯坦福桥对阵阿斯顿维拉的 WSL 比赛，因为我们知道我们在只打了两场比赛的情况下就已经实现了一个重要的目标。我们现在将参加本赛季的女子冠军联赛，从联赛阶段开始。切尔西已经进入联赛阶段，周五在尼翁抽签时我们将发现我们的对手。周六中午 12 点 35 分，我们将在斯坦福桥迎战阿斯顿维拉女足超级联赛，您仍然可以点击此处获取门票！ 切尔西：汉普顿、吉尔马、布坎南、青铜 (c)、沃尔什 (滨野 61)、波特、卡普坦、巴尔的摩 (萨尔维 61)、詹姆斯 (德拉戈尼 h-t)、比弗-琼斯 (拉斯 72) 未上场替补：彭、斯宾塞、布尔曼、麦凯布、努斯肯、汤普森 (卡彭特 61) 进球者：沃尔什 54 皇家社会队：阿鲁拉、弗洛伦蒂诺、维森特、阿帕里西奥、费尔南德斯（莱泽塔 84）、卡米诺、马林（阿帕里西奥 83）、埃吉古伦、塞伦弗罗因德（埃扎吉雷 58）、坎波、卡希诺瓦未上场替补：门迪布鲁、拉博德、马科斯、查孔、伊萨萨斯梅迪、索罗亚 黄牌：卡米诺 38、卡希诺瓦60、弗洛伦蒂诺 67 裁判：伊万娜·马丁西奇

news.title: Landon Emenalo completes loan move
news.title_zh: 兰登·埃梅纳洛完成租借
news.body_en: Landon Emenalo has joined Scottish champions Celtic on loan for the 2026/27 season. A versatile player, comfortable playing in defence and midfield, Emenalo was included in the senior squad for our pre-season tour of Asia and Australia. The 18-year-old, who first joined our Academy aged seven, featured for Xabi Alonso’s side in a victory over A-League club Western Sydney Wanderers. A regular starter for Chelsea Under-21s last season, Emenalo helped the Blues finish top of the Premier League 2 table. He also helped our Academy’s younger age group to be crowned Under-18 Premier League national champions by defeating Manchester City in the play-off final at Stamford Bridge. We look forward to monitoring Landon’s progress in Scotland as he gains valuable top-flight experience and wish him luck at Celtic.
news.body_zh: 兰登·埃梅纳洛 (Landon Emenalo) 租借加盟苏格兰冠军凯尔特人队 2026/27 赛季。埃梅纳洛是一位多才多艺的球员，在防守和中场方面表现出色，他被列入我们亚洲和澳大利亚季前赛的成年阵容中。这位 18 岁的球员七岁时首次加入我们的学院，代表哈维·阿隆索的球队战胜了 A 联赛俱乐部西悉尼流浪者队。埃梅纳洛上赛季是切尔西 21 岁以下青年队的常规首发球员，帮助蓝军在英超二级联赛积分榜上名列前茅。他还帮助我们学院的年轻组在斯坦福桥附加赛决赛中击败曼城，夺得 18 岁以下英超联赛全国冠军。我们期待着关注兰登在苏格兰的进步，因为他获得了宝贵的顶级联赛经验，并祝他在凯尔特人队好运。

news.title: Confirmed Chelsea line up vs Real Sociedad
news.title_zh: 确认切尔西对阵皇家社会的阵容
news.body_en: Sonia Bompastor has made four changes to her Chelsea starting XI for of our UEFA Women's Champions League qualifying round second leg against Real Sociedad. We head into the clash with a 5-2 advantage from the first leg at Plough Lane. The winner of the tie will make it through to the league phase of the competition – you can watch the game live and for free on the Chelsea website and the Chelsea Official App. Lucy Bronze comes into the side and takes the captain's armband for the evening. She will be joined in defence by Kadiesha Buchanan. The duo come into the side for Veerle Buurman and Katie McCabe, who are both named on the substitutes' bench. Chelsea Academy graduate Lexi Potter has been selected to start, with Sjoeke Nusken making way for her in midfield. Wieke Kaptein, meanwhile, has replaced Alyssa Thompson in the side. Chelsea: Hampton, Carpenter, Girma, Buchanan, Bronze (c), Walsh, Potter, Kaptein, Baltimore, James, Beever-Jones Chelsea substitutes: Peng, Spencer, Buurman, McCabe, Las, Sarwie, Nusken, Hamano, Dragoni, Thompson
news.body_zh: 索尼娅·邦帕斯托在欧洲女子冠军联赛预选赛第二回合对阵皇家社会的比赛中，对她的切尔西首发阵容做出了四项调整。首回合在普劳巷举行，我们以 5-2 的优势进入这场比赛。平局的获胜者将进入联赛阶段 - 您可以在切尔西网站和切尔西官方应用程序上免费观看比赛直播。露西·布朗兹走到了一边，并在晚上戴上​​了队长袖标。卡迪莎·布坎南 (Kadiesha Buchanan) 将与她一起辩护。这对搭档替补维尔勒·布尔曼和凯蒂·麦凯布，两人都被列入替补席。切尔西学院毕业生莱克西·波特被选为首发，中场由斯乔克·努斯肯为她让路。与此同时，维克·卡普坦（Wieke Kaptein）取代了阿丽莎·汤普森（Alyssa Thompson）的位置。切尔西：汉普顿、卡彭特、吉尔马、布坎南、青铜（中）、沃尔什、波特、卡普坦、巴尔的摩、詹姆斯、比弗-琼斯 切尔西替补：彭、斯宾塞、布尔曼、麦凯布、拉斯、萨尔维、努斯肯、哈马诺、德拉戈尼、汤普森
